book.astralfall.journal.title: ASTRAL JOURNAL
book.astralfall.journal.toc_hint: Click a chapter to jump to it.
book.astralfall.journal.quickstart:
§5§lQuick Start§r

1. Survive to §lnight§r.
2. Watch for §6falling stars§r.
3. Mine the crater's glowing core.
4. Smelt §9Starmetal§r.
5. Forge a §bStarblade§r.
6. Follow the quests: press §lL§r.
book.astralfall.journal.page1:
§5§lI. The Stars Fall§r

I was the last astronomer of the Observatory. We watched the sky for a thousand years. Then the sky started watching back.

The stars are §lfalling§r.
book.astralfall.journal.page2:
§5First steps§r

At §lnight§r, meteors streak across the sky and crash near you. Listen for the scream, watch for the fiery trail.

Run to the crater before it cools.
book.astralfall.journal.page3:
§5§lII. Starmetal§r

A fresh crater holds glowing §6Meteorite§r, §9Starmetal Ore§r and §bSkyshard Clusters§r.

You need an §liron pickaxe§r or better. Old §lImpact Sites§r hide ore too.
book.astralfall.journal.page4:
§5Smelting§r

Smelt §9Raw Starmetal§r into §9Starmetal Ingots§r.

Skyshards come from the crystal clusters. Break one into two §bStardust§r in a crafting grid.

Keep both. Everything is made from them.
book.astralfall.journal.page5:
§5First craft§r

§lStarmetal Pickaxe§r:
mines 3x3. Sneak to mine one block.

§lStarblade§r:
skyshard, ingot and stick in a column. Your first real weapon.
book.astralfall.journal.page6:
§5§lIII. Armour§r

§9Starmetal Armour§r (full set): you take §lno fall damage§r. Land from high up to release a §lMeteor Landing§r shockwave that flings enemies away.

Jump off cliffs on purpose.
book.astralfall.journal.page7:
§5Voidwalker Armour§r

Woven from §dVoid Essence§r.
Full set:
- Night vision
- Void Stalkers ignore you
- §lSneak in mid-air§r to blink forward through space.
book.astralfall.journal.page8:
§5§lIV. Weapons§r

§bStarblade§r
Right-click: Star Slash, a piercing crescent.
Sneak: Starlight Dash through enemies.
+50% vs void creatures.
book.astralfall.journal.page9:
§6Comet Maul§r
Hold right-click, aim, release: a meteor crashes where you look.
Sneak: Ground Slam.

§dRiftcaller§r
Right-click opens a black hole. Hits heal you.
book.astralfall.journal.page10:
§bConstellation Bow§r
No arrows. Full draw fires 5 homing stars.

§dSingularity Grenade§r
Throw it into a crowd.

§9Gravity Gauntlet§r
Hold on a mob to lift it, let go to hurl it. Sneak on a block to throw that instead.
book.astralfall.journal.page11:
§5§lV. Creatures§r

§bAstral Wisp§r
Drifts around fallen stars. Feed it §bStardust§r to tame it. It follows you, heals you and shoots gold stars.
Empty hand: sit/follow.
§d1 in 30 are Prismatic!
book.astralfall.journal.page12:
§5Void Stalker§r

§lIt cannot move while you look at it.§r
Look away and it runs. Ignore it too long and it appears §lbehind you§r.

Starlight hurts it. Fades at sunrise.
book.astralfall.journal.page13:
§6Meteorite Crawler§r

Hatches from dark meteors. It curls up and §lrolls§r at you.

Dodge so it hits a wall: it is §lstunned§r and takes §ldouble damage§r.
Rolling, it takes half.
book.astralfall.journal.page14:
§5Void Gazer§r

A floating eye. It glares for two seconds, then fires a §lgravity beam§r that throws you skyward.

Break line of sight while it charges. Pillars are your friends.
book.astralfall.journal.page15:
§5§lVI. Places§r

Craft an §bAstral Compass§r (compass + 4 skyshards). Right-click to find the nearest ruin; a trail of stars shows the way.
Sneak + use: change target.
book.astralfall.journal.page16:
§5Shattered Observatory§r

Our home, broken by a meteor. Guarded by stalkers and gazers.

§lTraps:§r Gravity Runes fling you up (§lsneak§r across). Starfire Vents erupt.
book.astralfall.journal.page17:
§5Secrets of the Observatory§r

At the top, the great §6telescope§r. Look through its eyepiece at night...

The §bStar Lock§r in the entrance hall hides our §lVault§r. It opens for a Skyshard.
book.astralfall.journal.page18:
§5Fallen Vessel§r

A ship that fell long ago, half buried in its own trench. Crawlers nest in the reactor.
Its holds carry gravity tech.

§5Sky Shrine§r
An island floating far above. Wings are kept there.
book.astralfall.journal.page19:
§5§lVII. Starstorms§r

Some nights the sky breaks: a §dStarstorm§r. Meteors fall every few seconds and shooting stars fill the sky.

Great for mining. Dangerous for everything else.
book.astralfall.journal.page20:
§6Fallen Stars§r

Rarely a §6golden§r meteor falls. It leaves a Fallen Star under a pillar of light you can see from far away.

Mine it for a §6Fallen Star Shard§r. Wisps gather there.
book.astralfall.journal.page21:
§5§lVIII. The Eclipse§r

Craft the §5Eclipse Sigil§r:
4 Void Essence
4 Skyshards
1 Fallen Star Shard

Use it on the §lAstral Altar§r atop the Observatory, or on one you craft.
book.astralfall.journal.page22:
§5Before the ritual§r

- Full armour, healing
- Starblade and bow
- Gauntlet, grenades
- A tamed wisp
- Open ground, pillars to hide behind

Night falls instantly.
book.astralfall.journal.page23:
§4Astraeus§r §8(Phase I)§r

§lMeteor Rain:§r keep moving.
§lStar Lance:§r a sweeping beam; strafe or hide.
§lCrystal Shards:§r homing; dodge or block.
§lSlam:§r don't stay close.
book.astralfall.journal.page24:
§4Gravity Collapse§r
It pulls you in, then explodes. Run outward the moment it spreads its arms.

§4Phase II§r (50%)
Summons stalkers and gazers. Opens black holes under you.
book.astralfall.journal.page25:
§4Phase III§r (20%)
The sky itself falls: constant meteors, faster attacks.

The shards regrow. Destroy it before the dawn.

When it dies, the sun rises.
book.astralfall.journal.page26:
§5§lIX. Beyond§r

Astraeus leaves:
§6Stellar Core§r
§6Eclipse Greatsword§r
§6Crown of Astraeus§r
and a fortune in starmetal.

The Crown rains golden stars on your enemies.
book.astralfall.journal.page27:
§6Eclipse Greatsword§r
Every hit charges the eclipse. At 12, right-click for the §lEclipse Nova§r.

§5Nebula Wings§r
Stellar Core + 4 Void Essence + 2 Phantom Membrane + 2 Skyshards.
book.astralfall.journal.page28:
§5§lX. Quests§r

Open §lAdvancements§r (L) and choose the §5Astralfall§r tab: every step from your first meteor to the end, with rewards.

Lost this book? Craft a Book + Gold Nugget.
book.astralfall.journal.page29:
§5For builders§r

Astral bricks, glass, star jars and meteorite blocks are all craftable.

§8Creative:§r §o/astralfall help§r lists showcase commands.

§8Keep watching the sky.§r
